articleTitle: Partial discharge pattern recognition of 10kV XLPE cable defects based on VMD and GA-BP
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: The study of cable partial discharge pattern recognition is of great importance for the stability of power cables. In the high voltage laboratory, a platform was established to test partial discharge signals of 10kV XLPE cable, such as metal impurities, water infiltration of main insulation, and scratches of main insulation, utilizing the high frequency current method. The entropy value of each modal component were studied by using variation modal decomposition for the collected PD signals.Characteristic quantities such as the power spectral entropy mean, fuzzy entropy mean, sample entropy mean of each modal component, and IMF1's fuzzy entropy value were chosen. To optimize the back propagation neural network algorithm for partial discharge pattern recognition, a genetic algorithm was employed.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant control of distributed drive electric vehicles based on yaw moment controller
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: To improve the safety and reliability of distributed drive electric vehicles, fault-tolerant control research is conducted in this paper. This paper compares fault-tolerant control of motor sudden shutdown fault in electric vehicles based on proportion integration and derivation (PID) controller and Fuzzy controller, to guarantee stability in the event of a distributed electric vehicle motor fault. The results show that both PID and Fuzzy controllers can be used to stabilize the vehicle speed and help achieve fault tolerant control of steering in low-speed single lane change (SLC) conditions, with the fuzzy controller being more effective.

articleTitle: Framework of privacy metric for location-based services
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In view of the privacy leakage problem of location based services (LBS), the academic community has proposed various location privacy protection mechanism(LPPM), and the protection effect of LPPM needs a means to measure. At present, measurement mechanisms mainly focus on the metric of location privacy or query privacy, or for a specific LPPM, which is not universal. In this paper, a generic measurement framework is proposed, in which, mobile user, LPPM and adversary are formalized, and performance criterion is used as metric, which considers the degree of protection and service utility. This metric framework considers both query privacy and location privacy, meanwhile, it can be applied to snapshot LBS and trajectory LBS. Finally, the effectiveness of the metric framework is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Investigation of the integrated CMV filter with different conductor placement of the PMSM
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Common-mode voltage (CMV) is inherently existing in the motor drive system with the PWM inverter and required to be reduced as much as possible. An integrated filter is proposed to reduce the hazards caused by common-mode voltage (CMV) by utilizing partial motor windings to replace the inductance inside the filter. Compared to conventional passive CMV filters, this proposed integrated filter omits the mass and the volume of the inductor, leading to a higher power density. The placement of the conductors of the motor windings as a part of the integrated filter has an impact on the performance of CMV reduction. This paper conducts a study of three different motor windings placement methods. The comparison of the motor performance is verified in the simulation results.

articleTitle: Maximum torque per ampere control of a PMa-SynRM based on a signal injection method considering the flux characteristics
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: The objective of this research was to devise an innovative approach for the operation of Permanent Magnet Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Machines (PMa-SynRMs) under the Maximum Torque Per Ampere (MTPA) condition. A comprehensive analysis of the MTPA condition was conducted, and the MTPA condition was subsequently derived from the input electrical power. The method proposed involves the injection of a constant frequency current signal, utilized for tracking the MTPA operating point in conjunction with the fundamental current responsible for torque generation. This technique eliminates the need for any machine parameters or pre-established looking-up tables, and it is robust to resistance, inductance, and flux variation. The frequency of the injected signal is in the range of several hundred hertz, and the performance of the MTPA tracking is virtually unaffected by load torque disturbance. The practicality of the proposed method was verified by the MATLAB simulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of power load and energy consumption in industrialized recirculating aquaculture system
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Through on-the-spot investigations on industrialized recirculating aquaculture companies, its power consumption is about 1.4 to 1.8 times that of traditional aquaculture models, and the large energy consumption of electricity load is the most important factor restricting its development. Through the investigation, it was found that the energy consumption of the aerator load accounted for the largest proportion of the power consumption of the system, and the proportion of the use time was the highest, and there was a large room for energy saving. The load of the aerator runs at a constant power for 24 hours, accounting for 38.5% of the total system power consumption. In actual production, switches and valves are often used to control the aerator, although it can effectively reduce energy consumption and improve the economic benefits of the enterprise. However, the aeration load is a large-scale power load, which is not suitable for frequent switching. Therefore, the method based on fuzzy PID is used to control the internal motor of the aerator with variable voltage, variable frequency and speed regulation. When analyzing different working conditions, the motor is controlled reasonably. , and calculate the energy consumption of the aerator at each moment, the results show that the use of frequency conversion speed regulation can effectively reduce energy consumption and improve the economic benefits of power consumption in factories.

articleTitle: Modeling of electromagnetic interference noise on inverter driven magnetic bearing of flywheel energy storage
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Inverter driven magnetic bearing is widely used in the flywheel energy storage. In the flywheel energy storage system. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) couplings between the flywheel motor drive system and the magnetic bearing and its drive system produce considerable EMI noise on the magnetic bearing, which will seriously affect the control signal quality of the magnetic bearing drive system and the stability of the magnetic bearing, and bring significant challenges to the high-speed flywheel system. In order to effectively suppress the EMI noise of system coupling, EMI coupling mechanism between the motor drive system and the magnetic bearing system in the flywheel energy storage system is investigated. In this paper, the flywheel energy storage system with inverter driven magnetic bearing is taken as the research object, and the common-mode EMI generation mechanism and expression form of flywheel energy storage high-speed motor are investigated. The conducted EMI coupling source and common-mode EMI coupling paths between the main drive motor and the inverter driven magnetic bearing system in the flywheel energy storage system are investigated, and the high frequency model of the system common-mode EMI is proposed.

articleTitle: Reliable transmission technology of spaceborne remote sensing data based on BeiDou short message communication
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Spaceborne remote sensing data is one of the crucial sources of data in accurate measurement systems, which provides data security for users to perform tasks in practical applications. When BeiDou short-message communication (BDSMC) is applied to the transmission of spaceborne remote sensing data, the success rate and timeliness of communication directly determine the effectiveness of data. However, BDSMC has several problems: a small amount of data is transferred each time, and the communication process is unreliable. To address these problems, this paper designs a long message fragmentation and reassembly protocol and proposes a feedback and retransmission mechanism for BeiDou user self-correction based on the majority voting decoder. The simulation results reveal that the proposed mechanism could efficiently enhance the success rate of spaceborne remote sensing data transmission, while reducing the communication delay caused by the traditional feedback and retransmission mechanism. By following this approach, spaceborne remote sensing data are efficiently and reliably transmitted based on the BDSMC.

articleTitle: Robust identification algorithm for power load parameters based on measured ambient signals and modified SSA
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: A load parameter identification method based on the measured ambient signals and the modified sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is proposed to address the problem that the traditional identification method is overly dependent on the fault disturbance type and cannot track the time-varying characteristics of the electric load. The key to load parameter identification is to calculate the predicted power of the load model and improve the optimization-seeking algorithm. First, a two-stage load power prediction model is proposed to increase the computational speed by decomposing the third-order state equation of the induction motor to meet the online identification requirements and to improve the algorithm's robustness against random disturbances by integrating the rotor motion equation. Then, the population initialization process and the iterative termination condition of the conventional SSA are improved, and the modified SSA is combined with convex optimization. The simulation case shows that the proposed algorithm has a high recognition accuracy, and the error is reduced by 18.9% compared with the genetic algorithm-based identification. A practical grid case in Hunan verifies the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of pipeline water generator
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: The development process of urban smart water network needs to rely on sensors along the line, but traditional batteries have shortcomings such as limited capacity and inconvenient replacement. In order to solve the problem of sensor power supply, 45mW micro-tubular water cooler is designed in this paper. The impeller is driven by water flow and the generator is driven by mechanical structure. According to the typical application at home and abroad, the mechanical structure of the pipe turbine is determined, the appropriate motor material is selected, and the electromagnetic structure of the motor is designed and optimized. Through finite element simulation, the no-load characteristics and external characteristics of the generator are analyzed. After optimization, the groove torque of the motor is 0.4mNm, the output torque is 7.2mNm and the rated power is 45mW. A prototype generator is manufactured, and the experimental results show that the back electromotive force of the generator under certain conditions accords with the simulation design.

articleTitle: Domain adaptation semantic segmentation for self-driving cars
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: As an extension of the traditional deep learning network, semantic segmentation aims to generate a class label for each pixel in the input image, thus grouping up together pixels that possess the same semantic label. It is always one of the key topics in computer vision domain, and it is also a vital concept in building self-driving automobile systems. One problem often met in real-life semantic segmentation problem is that researchers often can't provide a large enough dataset containing all diversely different scenes around the world, causing the model to underfit. In this article we show you how we use VGG16 deep learning model [7] to build a Fully Convolutional Network [5] as to achieve pixel-wise semantic prediction, and how we addressed aforementioned limitation by training the model using video game scenes from GTA5. Since there are style-level discrepancies between the game scenes and the real life scenes, we utilize Adversarial Domain Adaptation [2] to overcome problems caused by such domain shifts and to make the model perform better when working in real life scenes.

articleTitle: Test case design and evaluation for ECU of smart connected vehicles with full-scenario security model
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In recent years, the security issues of smart connected vehicles have attracted much attention. As the core component of the automotive electronic control system, whether Electronic Control Unit (ECU) can be tested correctly will directly affect the safety of smart connected vehicles. To improve the coverage and efficiency of ECU test cases for smart connected vehicles, this paper proposes a new automotive ECU testing model. Based on scenario testing and the three major safety aspects of automobiles, the model decomposes abstract functional testing scenarios into specific functional safety testing scenarios, expected functional safety testing scenarios, and information security testing scenarios, and then designs and evaluates test cases for each scenario. Through comparison, this model can comprehensively consider the actual working environment of the tested function and complete the testing of the ECU of smart connected vehicles more comprehensively, improving the testing efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-leaders alternated cooperative localization method based on improved cubature kalman filter
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Considering the weak observability of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) cooperative localization with one leader and reduced positioning accuracy due to sudden changes in the AUV's motion state in traditional single-leader position models, a two-leader alternated cooperative localization method based on an improved Cubature Kalman Filter (ICKF) algorithm is proposed. Unlike the traditional one-leader localization, the two-leader alternating localization method cooperatively corrects positioning errors using distance information from different leader AUVs at adjacent time points. To address the problem of increased positioning error due to changes in the AUV's motion trajectory, an adaptive correction criterion and correction method based on innovation are used to improve the cubature Kalman Filter and enhance the algorithm's robustness. The performance of the simulation demonstrates that the filtering accuracy of the proposed ICKF algorithm is much superior and it has more numerical stability than the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) and unscented Kalman filter (UKF) algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on three-phase fully controlled rectification control system
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of digitalization of three-phase fully controlled rectification, a method of three-phase fully controlled rectification based on DSP is designed. The phase sequence detection algorithm and the output algorithm of phase-shifting pulse are implemented based on the judgment. The phase sequence detection algorithm and the output algorithm of phase-shifting pulse are implemented based on the judgment of three-phase positive sequence, negative sequence and lacked phase by the state square wave of the three-phase electric power generated by the circuit. The phase sequence adaptive algorithm can judge the current phase sequence and output double narrow pulses according to the given control angle of the upper computer. The output voltage is adjusted by adjusting the output position of the double narrow pulse with the phase-shifting control algorithm by the timer to achieve the pull inverter protection and rectifier output. The experimental and simulation results are matched and show that the proposed method can realize digital three-phase fully controlled rectification.

articleTitle: Analysis of vegetation indices by time series clustering of drone rice monitoring data
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: To overcome the primary problem facing Japanese agriculture, farm work must be accurately and cost-effectively evaluated and visualized. One way of achieving this is through "Drone Rice Monitoring," which uses vegetation indices. However, research on vegetation indices has not advanced, and using them on farms is still challenging. This study proposes a novel method to evaluate and visualize the effects of individual farm work. Herein, a clustering of vegetation indices time series data obtained from continuous monitoring is performed. Subsequently, the results of the classification are compared with the growth of the crops to clarify the corresponding relationship with the vegetation indices. In this study, monitoring data is collected by varying the amount of fertilizer in each paddy field to visualize and evaluate the fertilizer application. In addition, Standardized Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (sNDRE) is developed for time-series analysis. As a result of using this vegetation indicator for two consecutive years, the paddy fields with the best clustering results are found to coincide with the optimal fertilizer amount, considering actual yields and income.

articleTitle: A new traffic model integrating headway deviation and predictive feedback control under V2X environment
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: By integrating headway deviation and predictive feedback control, we in this study provide a new traffic model under V2X environment. Then, the traffic stability conditions are derived to acquire the feedback gain range involving the response coefficient of the headway deviation. Simulation results show that the space-time and speed variation become smoother by cooperating headway deviation and predictive feedback control, which means that new consideration mitigates traffic jams under V2X environment. Also, one disturbance and multiple disturbances scenario is investigated for both space-time and speed variation with similar change trend.

articleTitle: Research on the structure of magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transmission coil
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Wireless power transfer technology can transmit electric energy wirelessly, and has obvious advantages compared with traditional power transmission methods. Under the trend of unmanned and intelligent power system, the use of magnetic coupling resonant wireless power transmission technology is helpful to solve the wireless power supply problem of intelligent equipment in power system. The structure of the resonant coil is the key factor affecting the efficiency of power transmission. This paper introduces several conventional shapes and several rare shapes of coil structures. Based on the study of the coil structure based on circuit theory and finite element analysis, it is concluded that each shape of the coil has the advantages and disadvantages of this technology, and the future development of this technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Small current measurement based on cross-type magnetic sensor array
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: This article proposes a new current measurement scheme based on a cross type magnetic sensor array. Firstly, an in-depth analysis was conducted on the effects of interference magnetic field, conductor eccentricity, and sensor array tilt on current measurement. The numerical simulation results show that the influence of the interference magnetic field is only 0.04%, and the maximum eccentricity error is 0.194%. At the same time, a new scheme was proposed to better improve the inclination angle error. When the inclination angle is 10°, the maximum inclination angle error is only 0.012%. Then, the performance of the cross type AMR magnetic sensor array was tested, and the results showed that the average measurement error of the cross type AMR sensor array at 3A current was 0.85%. This scheme has the ability of wire positioning, calibration, and magnetic field error compensation.

articleTitle: Research on trade strategy combination based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Combining the forecast results of gold and bitcoin returns with the portfolio optimization model can bring more stable and high returns to investors. In recent years, machine learning models have achieved great success in time series prediction. Based on LSTM model and Markowitz effective foreword curve. A hybrid prediction method is proposed to minimize the prediction error. Then, we use the data from September 2016 to September 2017 to perform first-order differentiation as the training and test set, and predicts the value trend of gold and Bitcoin to obtain a price change curve that is similar to the real data trend. By comparing sharp ratio, we examine maximum drawdown and rate of accumulated investment income to evaluate trading strategies. Finally, the classical sensitivity coefficient (SAF) is chosen to carry out six small adjustments of transaction costs for gold and bitcoin perspective, and the table of sensitivity factors of transaction costs to trading strategies is calculated.

articleTitle: Construction of machinery cost prediction model for green manufacturing and improved BP
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the accuracy of machinery remanufacturing cost prediction is not high, a machinery remanufacturing cost prediction model based on improved BP neural network was proposed. Firstly, the key influencing factors were identified based on the cost composition of mechanical product construction. Then, on the basis of the traditional BP neural network, particle swarm optimization algorithm was introduced to construct a machinery remanufacturing cost prediction model based on improved BP neural network. Finally, the constructed model was used to accurately predict the machinery cost. Experimental results show that the maximum error value of the relative error of the final result predicted by the model is 8.73%, the accuracy of the prediction result is high, the generalization ability is strong, the convergence speed is fast, and the training time is shorter. It is proved that the improved machinery remanufacturing cost prediction model based on BP neural network is feasible in practice.

articleTitle: Active disturbance rejection speed control of IPMSM based on quasi proportional resonance and feedback differential compensation linear extended state observer
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In the interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM) drive system, the conventional linear active disturbance rejection controller (C-LADRC) has insufficient tracking and disturbance rejection capabilities under the influence of periodic and non-periodic disturbances. To solve this problem, an improved linear active disturbance rejection controller (I-LADRC) combining quasi proportional resonance (QPR) and feedback differential compensation linear extended state observer (FBDC-LESO) is proposed in this paper. In I-LADRC, the conventional linear state error feedback (CLSEF) is replaced by QPR, mainly to suppress periodic disturbances. The feedback differential signal of the output value is introduced into the conventional linear extended state observer (C-LESO), so the estimation range of the aperiodic disturbance is widened without changing the bandwidth, and the system oscillation problem is avoided due to the excessive bandwidth of the observer. Finally, the validity and availability of the proposed method are proved through theoretical analysis and experiments.

articleTitle: The development trend of artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: This paper aims to discuss the subject concept, progress and future development trend of artificial intelligence( AI ), summarize the application prospect of AI technology, and put forward the problems and contradictions existing in the development of AI, It summarizes the ways of man-machine combination to solve this contradictory problem.

articleTitle: VSG control of grid-connected inverter based on improved PSO
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control technology can simulate the output characteristics of a synchronous generator. VSG can effectively solve the problem that the inertia and damping support capacity of the grid decreases after a large-scale distributed energy resource is connected to the grid. However, the selection of its control parameters is more complex. The unsuitable control parameters have a great influence on the grid-connection stability of the inverter. In order to solve this problem, the acceleration factor is linearly changed based on Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm, and it is used for the optimization calculation of VSG control parameters. The traditional VSG control method and the optimized VSG control method with different optimization algorithms were compared and analyzed by Simulink. The simulation results show the effectiveness and superiority of the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-threshold adaptive clustering group equalization control of energy storage battery pack
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the unavoidable consistency difference among cells in an energy storage battery pack, a multi-threshold adaptive clustering group equalization control method is proposed. First, a single-inductor energy storage equalization topology with simple structure, simple control and perfect balancing function is introduced. Second, while introducing the idea of cluster equalization, a group equalization control method is established based on adjacent cells with small consistency difference, so as to realize the transfer of equalization energy between battery groups containing different numbers of adjacent cells. Final, through simulation experiments, it is verified that the proposed cluster group equalization control can significantly improve the equalization speed while ensuring the equalization efficiency compared with the "one-to-one" equalization control based on the extreme difference or average.

articleTitle: Research on digital induction heating power supply control system
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the defects of the traditional analog power adjustment and phase-locked control system of induction heating power supply, a novel digital power adjustment and digital phase-locked loop (DPLL) control strategy is proposed, and the control sequence diagram is also given. At the same time, with TMS320F28377 as the core, the control system of parallel resonant induction heating power supply based on digital signal processor (DSP) is designed to realize constant voltage, constant current and constant power control of induction heating system, so as to enhance the digital control of induction heating power supply. The experimental results show that the system has high heating efficiency, good reliability, remarkable effect and high practical value.

articleTitle: Investigation on microgrid dispatching model of factory aquaculture park considering shiftable load
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Factory aquaculture park have the characteristics of close connection between aquaculture and energy demand, and can play an important role in reducing energy cost for the park by managing the energy consumption of the production workshop in the park. In this paper, a microgrid scheduling model of factory aquaculture park considering shiftable load is proposed, which consists of multivariate and multi-complex constraints, aims to minimize the overall operation and maintenance cost of microgrids in factory aquaculture park, and uses a combination of Binary Particle Swarm Optimization (BPSO) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to solve the problem with an improved particle swarm algorithm. Finally, taking the microgrid of a factory aquaculture park in Shandong, China as an example, the example results show that the microgrid dispatching model of factory aquaculture parks considering shiftable load proposed in this paper can effectively reduce the energy cost of factory aquaculture park.

articleTitle: Sea treasure target detection based on improved Yolov7 and TensorRT deployments
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: With the increasing demand for sea treasures such as sea cucumbers, sea urchins, and shells in the market, the global aquaculture industry has been booming. However, traditional counting methods for these sea treasures in aquaculture have high labor costs, low efficiency, and large counting errors. This article proposes an object detection optimization algorithm based on the YOLOv7 network, which reduces redundant calculations and memory access time through pruning and quantization to improve the efficiency of extracting spatial features. The algorithm is deployed on the Jetson Nano edge device through the TensorRT acceleration framework to achieve real-time target detection of underwater sea treasures. The results show that the improved algorithm has a mAP of 83.5%, which is an 8.5% improvement over the original YOLOv7 model's 75%, while ensuring recognition accuracy and achieving fast inference on the Jetson Nano experimental platform. The inference time for a single image is 85ms, and the inference speed is increased fourfold, enabling rapid recognition of sea treasures.

articleTitle: SAR / ISAR hybrid imaging technology based on multi-core DSP
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In the future, the rhythm of war will be accelerated and the battlefield environment will be complex and changeable. It is of great significance to obtain dynamic information of sea surface moving targets (such as cruisers, frigates, destroyers and aircraft carriers). Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) can image the target with high resolution all day, all weather and long distance, and has the ability to image and recognize the target. The high-precision imaging algorithm of Synthetic Aperture Radar for moving targets is usually complex and computationally intensive, which cannot meet the realtime requirements. In this paper, a SAR/ISAR hybrid imaging algorithm based on Keystone transform is proposed, and a single-chip multi-core DSP TMS320C6678 is used to realize real-time imaging processing architecture. The processing steps include SAR imaging based on Keystone transform, moving target detection, ISAR imaging based on range alignment and phase gradient autofocus. Finally, the imaging results of sea measured data verify the effectiveness of parallel processing of single-chip multi-core DSP.

articleTitle: Dispatchable variable droop control strategy for hydrogen production in microgrid
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Hydrogen production in microgrid has become a new research hotspot, and droop control is one of the most commonly used control methods in microgrid system. Actually, droop control has advantages of plug and play and convenient parallel operation of multiple inverters without communication, while automatic power distribution produces frequency deviation. So, in order to improve the power quality of microgrid system for hydrogen production, and eliminate the frequency static difference caused by droop control, an island operation inverter control method based on dispatchable variable droop coefficient was proposed. Using this method to adjust the output power in microgrid system and decrease the frequency steady state error. When converters' output power is limited, the method of dispatching is used to adjust the output power between inverters. At the same time, the dispatchability increases the flexibility of the system. The two-machine parallel system is simulated on MATLAB/Simulink, comparing traditional droop control and dispatchable variable droop control. In the case of accepting variable droop control strategy with instructions, the two inverters are still able to develop power according to their instructions. At the same time, the system's frequency was maintained at 50Hz. Figures of simulation results can verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy control based reduced-order observer for PMSM
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: This paper presents a new design for sensorless permanent magnet synchronous motor (PWSM) drive to enhance the robustness of stator resistance. The overall study in this paper is based on a cross-coupled high-order motor dynamic model. Then a fuzzy control based reduced-order flux observer with stator resistance adaptation is proposed. In addition, based on the stability requirements of the flux observer and the speed observer, the operating point is locally stable, with the exception of the zero frequency. Simulated loads operating at the rated speed were used to validate the proposed observer. With a fuzzy controller, choosing the gain for the reduced-order observer is comparatively simple.

articleTitle: A trust evaluation model based on fluctuation value and stable value in VANET
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: In the VANET, the high-speed mobility and dynamics of vehicles make the network topology change constantly, which makes it easy to be invaded and attacked by malicious nodes. Aiming at the characteristics of VANETs and the shortcomings of centralized storage, a trust evaluation model based on fluctuation value and stable value is proposed for VANETs, which is able to detect and cope with malicious attacks and also evaluate the trustworthiness of both data and mobile nodes in VANETs. In particular, we design the fluctuation value and stable value to exclude the recommendation of unstable nodes. At the same time, unstable nodes and malicious nodes are added to the attention list based on the fluctuation value. The experimental results show that the proposed trust model can identify malicious vehicles and has good performance to meet the requirements of vehicular network security.

articleTitle: Intelligent threat prevention and control system for new business terminals access in power system
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: The risk of network attacks facing the new power system is becoming increasingly prominent. The key to addressing this risk lies in changing the traditional network security protection concept of “once authenticated, always trusted” and establishing the zero-trust security concept of “Never Trust, Always Verify”. Although existing research focuses on concept elaboration and framework description, practical landing technology to implement zero-trust architecture remains limited. To fill this gap, we have designed a threat intelligent prevention and control system for new business terminal access in the power system that applies the zero-trust security protection concept to the field of new business terminal security in the power system. By introducing key technologies such as containerization and softwaredefined perimeter, we have established a new security protection architecture centred on identity with “unified identity authentication, continuous trust evaluation, dynamic access control.” Our aim is to ensure the security of terminal access.

articleTitle: A novel generative adversarial network based early fault diagnosis method for permanent magnet synchronous motor bearings
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Traditional fault diagnosis methods require a large amount of prior knowledge to ensure their diagnostic performance. However, when early faults occur in motor bearings, it is not possible to obtain fault samples that meet network training requirements. At the same time, the early fault characteristics are weak, which increases the difficulty of accurate diagnosis of bearing faults in permanent magnet synchronous motors. In response to the above problems, a novel generative adversarial network based permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) bearing diagnosis method is proposed. The idea of this method is to construct a new convolutional path unit (CP-unit). And the generator of residual CP-unit and full convolutional discriminator are fused. First, CP-unit uses high-density residual modules to generate deep representations that retain weak bearing feature information. Second, complete the iteration between the generator and discriminator in an end-to-end manner. Finally, compared with existing advanced methods, the effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper was verified.

articleTitle: Development status of non-contact high voltage measurement technology
publicationTitle: 3rd International Symposium on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ISEEIE 2023)
abstract: Power system voltage measurement plays a key role in the measurement of electric energy, the evaluation of the operating status of electrical equipment and the monitoring of transmission line overvoltage. Traditional contact voltage transformers can no longer meet the development trend of modern power systems, and non-contact voltage measurement technology is developing rapidly. The article describes several mainstream non-contact high voltage measurement techniques. From the perspectives of electricity and optics, the working principle of the corresponding sensors of each measurement technology is introduced, and the advantages, disadvantages and applicable scenarios of various voltage measurement technologies are summarized. Finally, the development direction of non-contact high-voltage measurement technology is prospected, which caters to the needs of modern power systems in the direction of high precision, miniaturization, digitization, and intelligence.
